findings.title: Duplicate self-improvement policy configuration files

evidence.observation: Both JSON and YAML formats exist concurrently for self_improvement_policy
Co-existing YAML policy file risks drift between configuration definitions

proposed_action.description: Standardize on a single configuration format for self_improvement_policy and remove the duplicate file

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents configuration desynchronization and ambiguous runtime policy loading

findings.title: Ollama available models unmapped in routing policy

evidence.observation: Models gemma4:12b, qwen3.5:9b, qwen3.5:4b, and qwen3.5:2b are available in Ollama but not assigned to any router task types

proposed_action.description: Review routing policy to evaluate whether gemma4:12b or qwen3.5 variants should supersede existing tier models or be purged from disk

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures local model capacity is efficiently utilized and clarifies model lifecycle management

findings.title: Model cold start latency and unpopulated loaded models

evidence.observation: Router average latency is 7478ms while loaded_models is currently empty

proposed_action.description: Configure keep-alive pre-warming or persistence for frequent local models such as gemma3:4b to avoid repeated cold-start loading overhead

findings.expected_benefit: Reduces invocation latency for high-frequency routing tasks like classify-capture and summarise-note
